headline: 句式工具箱 · 换一道题也还能用的句子
lead: 下面这些不是「高级词汇」，是骨架：带底线的部分换成你自己的内容，其余词原样保留，句子就成立——所以能跨题复用。每条都写清「为什么这么写」，再加一条「别这么写」；后者比前者更值钱，因为分基本都丢在误用上。背支架，不背句子：考场上真正省时间的是「这一段该用哪种句式」。

groups.title: Task 1 · 开头改写
groups.sub: 一句话交代身份，不评价、不写数字

items.frame: The [[line graph]] compares [[the number of visitors to three London museums]] in [[London]] over [[a twenty-year period]].
items.zh: 四件事各占一个位置：图表类型、对象、地点或范围、时间跨度。四块齐全，比只写「图表显示了……」更像 7 分。
items.warn: 不要照抄题目原句。同样的信息换掉主谓就算改写，一字不改照搬会被判为没有改写能力。

items.frame: The [[bar chart]] shows how [[the share of renewable energy]] changed between [[2000]] and [[2020]].
items.zh: 题目本身是个 how 从句时，用 shows how + 变化动词；比 shows the changes in 更短、更自然。
items.warn: 不要用 shows the trend of 开头——那是机构模板的标志，而且只有两个时间点时 trend 并不准确。

items.frame: The table gives a breakdown of [[student enrolment in higher education]] across [[six countries]] in [[2019]].
items.zh: 静态表格用 breakdown of / figures for，不用 change——没有时间轴就没有「变化」可言。
items.warn: 表格题写 change / increase 是硬伤，会被判成误读图表。

items.frame: The two maps show [[the same coastal area]] before and after [[a large-scale redevelopment]].
items.zh: 双图题要把「同一地点、两个时点」说明白，before and after 一句话解决。
items.warn: 不要分别介绍两张图；读者必须先知道它们描述的是同一个地方。

items.frame: The diagram outlines the stages by which [[waste paper]] is [[recycled]].
items.zh: 流程图用 the stages by which / the process of，动词用一般现在时被动语态。
items.warn: 流程题写过去时是高频时态错误——流程描述的是常态，不是某次发生的事。

groups.title: Task 1 · 概述句
groups.sub: 全篇只有两句的预算，却决定一半的 Task Achievement

items.frame: Overall, [[X]] rose steadily while [[Y]] declined, and [[Z]] remained broadly stable.
items.zh: 一条主线、一条反向、一条持平，句式的三个位置各占一种走势，三条线以上的图最省字。
items.warn: 概述里出现具体数字，等于提前把细节段的活做完，细节段会变得无话可说。

items.frame: Overall, the most striking change was the shift from [[A]] to [[B]].
items.zh: 图里有一个压倒性变化时，直接点出来，比罗列三条更果断。
items.warn: 只有两条线、且都在缓涨的图不要用 striking——最高级需要有事实支撑。

items.frame: Overall, [[A]] and [[B]] moved in opposite directions, with the gap between them widening throughout [[the period]].
items.zh: moved in opposite directions 一次交代两个方向，后面 with 结构补出差距变化，信息密度立刻上来。
items.warn: 不要写 both increased and decreased——同一主体不能同时做两件事。

items.frame: Overall, [[X]] overtook [[Y]] in [[2010]] and held its lead to the end of the period.
items.zh: 有交叉点的图，概述就该写交叉，而不是各自涨了多少。
items.warn: overtake 只用一次就够，细节段再写具体数字，不要在概述里把交叉点讲两遍。

items.frame: Overall, the process consists of [[four]] main stages, beginning with [[collection]] and ending with [[packing]].
items.zh: 流程图标准概述：几个阶段 + 起点 + 终点，一句话收住整张图。
items.warn: 不要逐步骤复述；概述只报数量与首尾。

items.frame: Overall, the area was transformed from [[a largely rural landscape]] into [[a residential and commercial district]].
items.zh: 地图题概述用 transformed from A into B，比 there are many changes 具体得多。
items.warn: 地图题别用 increase / decrease 描述建筑，要用 built / demolished / replaced / converted。

groups.title: Task 1 · 起点与静态值
groups.sub: 细节段第一句：先把排名和起点钉住

items.frame: In [[2000]], [[Museum B]] was the largest of the three, at [[600,000 visitors]], followed by [[Museum A]] at [[500,000]].
items.zh: 先给最高值，再用 followed by 带出第二，读者一次拿到排名和两个数字。
items.warn: 不要把三个数字平铺成三句 the number of X was…，那是列清单，不是比较。

items.frame: [[Hotels]] accounted for [[40 per cent]] of the total, the largest single share.
items.zh: 饼图和占比题的核心动词是 account for，后面接比例。
items.warn: account for 后面接比例或构成，接具体人数要用 make up；两者不能混。

items.frame: [[Rented flats]] stood at [[just under a third]] of [[all households]].
items.zh: 精确值不确定时用 just under / just over / roughly，这是允许的模糊区间，不算含糊其辞。
items.warn: 图上写死的 40% 就写 40%，不要改成 about 40%——有准数反而模糊会被看作读不准。

items.frame: [[Japan]] had by far the highest figure, at [[45,000 tonnes]].
items.zh: by far 只在差距明显时使用，一用就必须跟最高级。
items.warn: 差距不大却写 by far，是 7 分卷最常被扣的表达失准。

items.frame: Only a small minority — around [[one in ten]] — chose to [[rent rather than buy]].
items.zh: 把百分比换成 one in ten / a quarter / two thirds，句子比 10% / 25% 更有语感。
items.warn: 同一段里数字表达要统一，一会儿百分比一会儿分数，比较会变得读不下去。

groups.title: Task 1 · 趋势与幅度
groups.sub: 别只会 increase 和 decrease

items.frame: [[Museum A]] climbed from [[500,000]] to [[800,000]] over [[the two decades]].
items.zh: from A to B 是最省字的变化结构，配 climbed / fell / rose 使用。
items.warn: climb from…to… 中间不要再插 by——from/to 和 by 是两套结构。

items.frame: [[Enrolment]] rose sharply in [[the first decade]] before levelling off.
items.zh: before + -ing 把两段走势压进一句，是 Task 1 里性价比最高的结构。
items.warn: before levelling off 的主语必须还是同一个主体，换主语要另起一句。

items.frame: [[Museum B]] peaked at [[900,000]] in [[2010]] before falling back to [[700,000]].
items.zh: peak at 后面直接接峰值和时间，再用 before 补回落。
items.warn: peak 是瞬间动词，不能写 was peaking at 然后持续十年。

items.frame: [[The figure]] fluctuated between [[40]] and [[50 tonnes]] but ended the period close to where it began.
items.zh: fluctuate 必须配 between / around，否则读者不知道波动范围。
items.warn: 只有两个时间点的图不能写 fluctuated——至少三个点才谈得上波动。

items.frame: [[The number of overseas students]] more than doubled, from [[12,000]] to [[27,000]].
items.zh: 倍数动词（double / halve / treble）比 increased by 100% 自然得多。
items.warn: double 后面直接接数字，不要写 doubled by。

items.frame: [[Museum B]] grew at a much faster rate than [[Museum A]], widening the gap from [[100,000]] to [[250,000]].
items.zh: 把「速度差」和「差距变化」放进一句，这是 Task 1 拿高分的核心比较方式。
items.warn: 只说 both increased 而不说谁快，等于没有比较；比较分就丢在这里。

items.frame: The figure for [[camping]] remained unchanged at [[20 per cent]] throughout the period.
items.zh: 完全不变的数据也必须写——不写就是漏掉主要特征。
items.warn: remained unchanged 后面不要加 by，by 只用来表示变化量。

groups.title: Task 1 · 比较、交叉与排序
groups.sub: Task 1 的分数多半来自比较，而不是描述

items.frame: [[Museum B]] overtook [[Museum A]] in [[2010]], when the former reached [[900,000]] and the latter [[650,000]].
items.zh: the former / the latter 避免重复两个名字，同时把交叉点的双方数字补齐。
items.warn: the former / the latter 只能用于两者，三方比较请直接写名字。

items.frame: The gap between [[the two museums]] narrowed from [[100,000]] to [[50,000]].
items.zh: 差距本身也是数据，narrowed / widened 能把两条线的关系说清楚。
items.warn: 差距缩小不等于数值下降，别顺手写成 both figures fell。

items.frame: [[Spending on health]] was twice as high as [[spending on transport]] by [[the end of the period]].
items.zh: 倍数比较（twice / three times as high as）比 100% more than 清楚。
items.warn: twice as high as 后面接的是比较对象，不是数字。

items.frame: Although [[Museum B]] began the period well ahead of [[Museum A]], the two were almost level by [[2020]].
items.zh: 让步从句写「起点谁领先」，主句写「终点追平」，一句讲完一个完整故事。
items.warn: although 和 but 不能同现，这是中国考生最高频的语法错。

items.frame: [[Camping]], by contrast, was the only category that [[declined]].
items.zh: by contrast 用于「其余都在涨，只有它跌」，是真正的对比，不是万能连接词。
items.warn: by contrast 与 on the contrary 不同，后者用来反驳前一句，图里几乎用不到。

groups.title: Task 1 · 合并同类项
groups.sub: 六个数字不要写六句，要分组

items.frame: The [[three]] categories that grew all did so at a similar pace, gaining between [[8]] and [[11 points]].
items.zh: 同类项合并是 Coherence 的直接证据：先把相同的归在一起，再点差异。
items.warn: 合并后仍要给范围，否则读者不知道「相似」到什么程度。

items.frame: While [[the older age groups]] shrank, [[the younger ones]] expanded.
items.zh: while 引出对照，是段落内部最自然的切分方式。
items.warn: while 后面要接完整从句；接名词短语会变成悬垂结构。

items.frame: Only [[two]] of the [[six]] countries recorded a fall, and both were in [[Southern Europe]].
items.zh: 用数量词收束一组数据，比逐个报国名省一半字数。
items.warn: 说了 only two 就必须说清是哪两个，否则等于省略信息。

items.frame: The remaining [[countries]] showed no clear pattern, moving by less than [[three points]] in either direction.
items.zh: 无法归类的数据要给一个诚实的处理方式，而不是硬编一个趋势。
items.warn: 没看清就说没看清；编造趋势比不写更糟。

groups.title: Task 1 · 流程与步骤
groups.sub: 顺序词 + 被动语态，一条链不要断

items.frame: The first stage involves [[collecting used cans from households]].
items.zh: involves + -ing 是流程题第一句最稳的写法。
items.warn: involves 后面必须是名词或动名词，不能接 to do。

items.frame: Once [[the material has been sorted]], it is [[crushed into flat sheets]].
items.zh: once + 现在完成时表示「前一步做完之后」，比 after 更强调先后完成。
items.warn: once 从句用现在完成时、主句用一般现在时；两边都写过去时会把流程变成历史事件。

items.frame: After being [[melted down]], [[the metal]] is poured into [[moulds]].
items.zh: after being + 过去分词省掉一个从句，是流程图最常用的压缩结构。
items.warn: after being 的主语必须和主句一致，否则会变成悬垂结构。

items.frame: The final stage sees [[the finished sheets]] [[packaged and dispatched to retailers]].
items.zh: see + 宾语 + 过去分词用来收尾，比 lastly 有分量。
items.warn: see 这种用法只适合最后一两步，全文都用会显得刻意。

items.frame: The most extensive change was the replacement of [[the playing field]] with [[a car park]].
items.zh: replacement of A with B 一次说清「谁没了、谁来了」。
items.warn: change 后接 of；写成 the change from…into… 当主语时会缺动词。

items.frame: A new [[housing estate]] was built on the site of [[the former factory]].
items.zh: on the site of 是地图题的固定搭配，表示「原址新建」。
items.warn: 不要写 on the place of 或 in the position of，两者都不地道。

items.frame: The [[harbour]] was extended to [[the north]], while [[the old warehouse]] was demolished.
items.zh: while 把两处改动并列，避免一句一个改动地把段落写成清单。
items.warn: 别描述图上看不出的精度（如 5 metres east），会被判为错误信息。

items.frame: Little changed in [[the south of the island]], apart from [[the widening of the access road]].
items.zh: 没变的区域也要交代，apart from 用来收住唯一的例外。
items.warn: little changed 是「基本没变」；完全没变要用 nothing changed。

groups.title: Task 2 · 引入背景
groups.sub: 不要抄题目，先把话题放进现实语境

items.frame: It is often argued that [[longer school days raise attainment]], but the evidence is less clear-cut than it first appears.
items.zh: 先复述一种流行说法，再声明证据不足，为后面的立场留出空间。
items.warn: that 后面必须是可以被争论的观点，不能是人人同意的事实。

items.frame: Few issues divide opinion more sharply than [[the question of how much personal data companies should hold]].
items.zh: 话题本身争议性强时用这句开场，比 nowadays 有力得多。
items.warn: 争议性弱的话题（如「阅读有益」）用这句会显得夸张。

items.frame: In many countries, [[remote work]] has become an everyday part of [[professional life]].
items.zh: 把话题落到具体社会现象上，避免空泛的 with the development of society。
items.warn: with the development of society / economy 这类开头几乎等于没有开头。

items.frame: The past decade has seen a marked shift in how [[young people consume news]].
items.zh: 时间段 + see + 名词化，是书面语里最省力的背景句。
items.warn: see 的主语必须是时间段或地点，不能是人。

groups.title: Task 2 · 亮明立场
groups.sub: 观点类没有明确立场，Task Response 最高 5 分

items.frame: This essay argues that [[public libraries remain essential]], largely because [[they guarantee equal access to information]].
items.zh: 立场加理由一次给全，读者立刻知道你站在哪边、为什么。
items.warn: argue that 后面必须是完整命题，不能只塞一个名词短语。

items.frame: I would argue that [[the benefits outweigh the drawbacks]], provided that [[strict age verification is enforced]].
items.zh: 利弊类给出「有条件支持」，比无条件 outweigh 可信得多。
items.warn: provided that 后面必须是真的限制条件；写 provided that it is good 等于没写。

items.frame: On balance, I believe [[the ban is justified]], though not without reservations about [[its effect on small businesses]].
items.zh: on balance 表示权衡之后的结论；though not without 让步但不翻立场。
items.warn: 让步写到让读者以为你改主意了，就是立场不稳。

items.frame: This is not to say that [[technology should be restricted]]; rather, [[its use in classrooms needs clearer rules]].
items.zh: 先否掉一个可能的误解，再说真正的观点，论证密度很高的一句。
items.warn: rather 后面必须真的纠正前半句，不能只是换个说法重复。

groups.title: Task 2 · 让步与反驳
groups.sub: Coherence 的分水岭：你能不能公平地处理对方

items.frame: Admittedly, [[remote work]] has its costs; however, these are outweighed by [[the time saved on commuting]].
items.zh: Admittedly + however 是最稳的先让后驳结构，一句完成一个完整回合。
items.warn: however 后面要接真正的反驳，不能只是「但是也很重要」这种空话。

items.frame: It could be objected that [[testing deters cheating]]. Yet this assumes [[students are motivated by grades alone]], which is rarely the case.
items.zh: 指出对方论证里隐含的假设，再攻击假设——比直接说对方错高一级。
items.warn: 要真的写出那个假设；停在 It could be objected that 之后不接理由等于没反驳。

items.frame: While there is some truth in the claim that [[advertising informs consumers]], it overlooks [[the pressure it places on low-income families]].
items.zh: 承认部分正确再指出遗漏，是讨论类和利弊类最常用的句式。
items.warn: overlook 后面要接具体被忽略的因素，不能接 it is wrong。

items.frame: Even if [[longer hours were proven to raise scores]], it would not follow that [[schools should extend the day]].
items.zh: 虚拟语气 + not follow that，专门用来切断对方的推理链。
items.warn: were / would 必须配套；写成 even if it is true, it would not follow 会语法不一致。

groups.title: Task 2 · 因果与机制
groups.sub: 说清「怎么发生的」，分数就上去了

items.frame: [[Rising rents]] place considerable pressure on [[young families]], which in turn leads to [[longer commutes and lower savings]].
items.zh: A 压 B、B 导致 C，一条三环因果链，比 because 更能展开。
items.warn: which in turn 只指代紧挨着的那个名词，指代错就是逻辑错。

items.frame: The root of the problem lies not in [[the technology itself]] but in [[how it is used at home]].
items.zh: not in A but in B 把归因纠正过来，问题解决类特别适用。
items.warn: not…but… 两边结构必须平行：左边介词，右边也要介词。

items.frame: This creates a self-reinforcing cycle: the more [[time spent on screens]], the less [[sleep children get]].
items.zh: the more…the less… 是描述恶性循环最紧凑的结构。
items.warn: the more 后面不能有谓语重复；the more people use 少了宾语。

items.frame: Unless [[regulators act soon]], [[the problem]] is likely to worsen.
items.zh: unless 引出唯一能改变结果的条件，用来加强紧迫感。
items.warn: unless 本身已含否定，后面不能再加 not。

groups.title: Task 2 · 举例与证据
groups.sub: 例子要具体，数据不要编

items.frame: Take the case of [[city-centre schools]], where [[pupils often travel over an hour each way]].
items.zh: Take the case of 是最不像模板的举例方式，后面接一个真实可想的场景。
items.warn: 编造具体统计（如「2019 年 73% 的学生」）属于伪造证据，考官看得出来，论证也不会因此更强。

items.frame: A clear illustration of this is [[the shift to online banking]], which [[has closed hundreds of local branches]].
items.zh: 当例子本身就是论点的延伸时，用 illustration 比 for example 更贴切。
items.warn: for example 不要连用三次；同段出现两次以上就换成 illustration / case / instance。

items.frame: Evidence from [[several European cities]] suggests that [[congestion charges reduce traffic without harming trade]].
items.zh: 用 suggests 而不是 proves，是对证据强度的正确把握。
items.warn: suggests 后面接完整从句，不能接名词短语。

items.frame: The same pattern appears in [[rural areas]], where [[public transport has been cut even more sharply]].
items.zh: 第二个例子用 the same pattern 承接，比再来一个 for example 连贯得多。
items.warn: 两个例子必须真的同类；硬凑出来的「同样」会被判为论证不清。

groups.title: Task 2 · 限定与折中
groups.sub: 绝对化的结论最好写；有条件的结论最可信

items.frame: This is likely to be true only where [[public transport is reliable enough to replace the car]].
items.zh: 给结论加地理或制度条件，避免 overgeneralisation。
items.warn: 限定条件要能检验；where the situation is different 等于没有限定。

items.frame: The answer depends largely on [[the age of the child and the content being viewed]].
items.zh: 题目问得过于绝对时，这句话可以同时保住 discuss 的双方。
items.warn: depends on 之后必须真的展开，只说 depends 会被看作回避问题。

items.frame: A blanket ban would be a disproportionate response; [[targeted regulation of advertising]] is preferable.
items.zh: 一刀切 vs 精准监管，是政策类题目最出彩的一组对立。
items.warn: 用了 targeted regulation 就要在下一句说清怎么 targeted。

items.frame: Rather than [[building new roads]], governments should [[invest in bus networks]].
items.zh: rather than 放在句首直接给替代方案，比单纯否定有建设性。
items.warn: rather than 两边结构要一致：rather than build…, … should invest…（都用动词原形）。

groups.title: Task 2 · 段落过渡
groups.sub: 段间衔接靠逻辑，不靠 Firstly / Secondly

items.frame: Beyond the practical argument, there is also a question of principle: [[who owns personal data]].
items.zh: 从实用层面转到原则层面，是一段自然的推进，不是换话题。
items.warn: 过渡句必须承接上一段的结论；凡是能放进任何文章的过渡句都是模板。

items.frame: This problem, however, is not beyond remedy: [[restaurant groups could sell two sizes at two prices]].
items.zh: 在问题段与方案段之间搭桥，让文章从「是什么」走到「怎么办」。
items.warn: 说了 not beyond remedy 就必须马上给方案，否则是空头承诺。

items.frame: The more pressing question is not whether [[to regulate]], but [[who should do it]].
items.zh: 把讨论推进到更深一层，比 another reason is 有方向感。
items.warn: 只有前面确实讨论过一个次要问题时，才能说 more pressing。

items.frame: It is at this point that [[the role of schools]] becomes relevant.
items.zh: 把前面铺的两个概念接起来，适合四段式里第三段开头。
items.warn: 这是强调句；去掉 It is…that 之后句子必须仍然完整。

groups.title: Task 2 · 收尾
groups.sub: 只重述立场，不加新论点

items.frame: In conclusion, [[restricting advertising to children]] is, on balance, [[justified]].
items.zh: 结论段第一句就重述立场，后面只做总结，不开新战场。
items.warn: 结论段出现新理由就是新论点，会被算作结构问题。

items.frame: What is needed is not [[fewer screens]] but [[clearer rules about when they are used]].
items.zh: 把结论压成一句对照，比重复正文更有决断力。
items.warn: not…but… 是强断言；正文没论证到就别用。

items.frame: If [[youth unemployment]] is to be addressed, [[vocational training]] must come first.
items.zh: 条件句收尾，把建议落到优先级上。
items.warn: be to 结构表「要实现」；写成 if X will be addressed 就不对了。

items.frame: Ultimately, the question is less about whether [[to use artificial intelligence]] than about how [[to keep it accountable]].
items.zh: 把讨论从「要不要」抬到「怎么做」，两问类最好的收束。
items.warn: less about…than about… 两边要同类成分；一边从句一边名词会失衡。
